verdict.rationale: Oyster documents employer-of-record hiring in 120+ countries without local entities. It also documents an API flow to create and submit EOR employments with country-specific rulesets, which kicks off onboarding and contract generation. Multi-country payroll is claimed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of payroll for the customer's own (owned) entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the EOR employment experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll

citations.quote: Hire compliantly with expert guidance and powerful automations without setting up local entities. Compliant employment in 120+ countries
create a draft EOR employment, update the job details, and submit the employment to kick off the employment onboarding and contract generation.
The required fields, possible values and field validations often vary by country, use the Rulesets for updating employment of particular country and subdivision
